files.one_line: Full steel-wire pretreatment chain written (degrease/ultrasonic, anodic electroclean, HCl pickle+activation, Wood's Ni strike, Watts/sulfamate Ni, non-cyanide-preferred Cu strike, nickel-free white-bronze/Pd stacks, rinse/drag-out discipline) with 10 solution recipes at published handbook ranges, 12-step forked mild-steel/stainless sequence incl. H-embrittlement bake, ductility ranking for plate-then-form (sulfamate Ni best), EN 1811/ASTM B571/B850-class acceptance tests, hazard classes as FACT, proprietary packages honestly tagged UNKNOWN; DIY verdict HIGH with cyanide route explicitly excluded.

Classic KAu(CN)2 free-cyanide route documented as the reference chemistry: 3 solutions (gold strike, 24k soft-gold build, decorative flash/color variant) with published-typical compositions and windows, full steel-wire prep chain (Wood's Ni strike + sulfamate Ni underplate), Faraday-derived deposition rates, ASTM B488/B568/B571/B735 + EN 1811 test set, and a NOT-RECOMMENDED-for-home-DIY verdict driven by fixed cyanide licensing/HCN-monitoring floors — soft 24k deposit is the most ductile gold for plate-then-form, but form-first-then-plate remains the robust answer to Q3.

Acid hard gold (Co/Ni-hardened citrate KAu(CN)2, pH 3.5-5.0, 130-200 HV) documented as the right wear layer for steel-wire rings via degrease-pickle-Ni-barrier-strike stack, DIY-feasible with bought commercial solutions, but the deposit is brittle so the ring MUST be formed before plating, not after.

Sulfite Au(I) cyanide-free gold plating (plus mixed sulfite-thiosulfate variant and dilute-sulfite strike): the default DIY/home-shop route — no cyanide anywhere, near-100% cathode efficiency, ductile 24k soft gold that uniquely tolerates gentle plate-then-form — paid for with weak-complex disproportionation instability (short bath life, mandatory filtration/lids/no-air-agitation, acid-drag-in kill-shot), softer deposits than Co-hardened cyanide gold unless As/Tl dopants re-import hazmat, and weaker strike behavior; all compositions given as published handbook ranges with FACT/ESTIMATE tags and 10 UNKNOWNs deferred to supplier TDS/regulators.

Rectifier-free ENIG-family stack (electroless Ni-P + immersion/autocatalytic gold): displacement gold self-limits at ~0.1 um flash class and brittle Ni-P bans plate-then-form, so for steel wire this is NOT the finish route — its honest factory roles are metallizing non-conductive houseware (glass/ceramic seed for later electroplating), uniform barrier+seed on complex/hollow formed shapes, and an honest budget gold-flash tier; 4 solutions documented (mid-phos EN, CN-type and CN-free immersion Au, autocatalytic builder) with published-range compositions, black-pad/MTO failure modes, and Pb-free+CN-free product pairing recommended for DIY.

Brush/pen selective gold plating documented as the vertical's repair/accent/learning route (cheapest DIY entry, highest feasibility, room-temp ml-scale chemistry) with 4 solution systems (cyanide and cyanide-free gold pens, brush Ni undercoat, prep pair), full 8-step tankless sequence, honesty-tagged handbook ranges, and explicit limits: not a whole-piece production route, sub-micron thickness realism, plates after forming by nature (the corrective for the plate-then-form problem).

DC magnetron gold sputtering fully documented (chamber-to-vent 12-step sequence, Ar/target/interlayer consumables with published windows, Ti/Cr/NiCr adhesion, dry no-effluent safety profile); verdict: DIY-feasible batch/in-vacuum reel-to-reel at ~USD 4-8k + target metal, continuous rubber-seal wire feed honestly rejected in favor of differential-pumped orifice stages (industrial) or in-chamber spools, and form-first-coat-second for rings since interlayers crack at ~1-2% strain.

Evaporation is the most DIY-feasible route (soft Au flash, works on glass) while the scratch-resistant premium look = arc-ion-plated TiN/ZrN + 0.05-0.3 um Au cap (watch-industry stack, ~2000-2400 HV, beats sputtering on adhesion/rate) — but it is batch, line-of-sight, form-first-coat-last (ceramic cracks on bending, killing plate-then-form and the continuous wire-feed concept), and realistically job-shop toll-coated, not home-built.

files.one_line: Gold-filled wire (mill-clad ductile karat skin, FTC 1/20 marking class) is the industry's engineered answer to form-after-gold — buy stock, never plate-then-form; leaf gilding covers non-conductive houseware; fire gilding documented hazards-only [FACT: Hg H330/H360D/H372, Minamata] with all operating parameters withheld as prohibited.

Post-plating topcoat family written: BTA + thiol/SAM anti-tarnish dips, cathodic e-coat clear (the jewelry precision tool, 30-120 V / 120-180 C cure), sol-gel nano-ceramic hybrid (6-9H houseware champion), lacquer classes (Incralac-acrylic preferred; NC and 2K-PU-spray ruled out for DIY on fire/isocyanate hazard [FACT]), and PVD ZrN/DLC hard caps as cross-ref comparator; full scratch-resistance ladder with trade-offs, topcoat-LAST sequencing rule (no coat-then-form — brittle-film physics), food-side-bare-gold design rule (food-contact clearance = [UNKNOWN per market]), EN 1811+EN 12472 note that lacquer alone is not Ni-release compliance; verdict: most DIY-compatible family in the factory (dip + benchtop e-coat kit + dedicated oven), directly serving the minimum-gold-per-piece goal.

Wrote the full testing/QC/acceptance gate file: XRF (ASTM B568) + coulometric (ISO 2177) thickness, ASTM B571 adhesion battery (the wrap test doubles as the empirical plate-then-form verdict), ferroxyl/nitric-vapor porosity (critical on steel core), salt spray + artificial sweat + mandatory EN 1811 nickel release, Taber/Bass wear classes, karat verification, FTC/ISO 27874 label ladder (flash <0.175 um / electroplate >=0.175 / heavy >=2.5 / vermeil = sterling-only, never steel), plus a 9-step small-shop qualification-then-per-batch protocol with a near-zero-capex Tier 0 DIY kit; all standard classes tagged FACT, recipes/temperatures tagged ESTIMATE, proprietary/regulatory specifics tagged UNKNOWN.

honesty_note: All compositions/windows are typical published handbook/TDS ranges tagged [FACT]/[ESTIMATE] inside each file; parameters that could not be stated honestly are [UNKNOWN — needs supplier TDS] (never invented); hazard classes carried as [FACT]; fire gilding in mechanical_and_historical is documented hazards-only with operating parameters deliberately withheld (prohibited process).
